summary: PBF Energy filed an 8-K reporting that indirect subsidiary PBF Holding and co-issuer PBF Finance priced $500 million of 0% senior unsecured exchangeable notes due 2032 in a private offering exempt from registration, expected to close September 17, 2026; underwriters received a 13-day option for up to $50 million more. No price/share, premium, board recommendation, or advisor was disclosed. Proceeds and exchange mechanics are unspecified, though exchangeable notes can create equity overhang. Watch settlement, use of proceeds, and any exchange-price or capped-call terms in the indenture.
